keys.hint: Open the link in HAPP, Hiddify or any other VPN client.

settings.title: Server profiles
settings.hint: Connect to the server over SSH to manage profiles: create separate keys for devices or delete existing ones.
settings.passwordNote: The password is never stored — it is requested on every connection.
settings.createHint: One device — one key. Enter a name, protocol and copy count (profile family).
settings.protocolPrompt: Choose how traffic should bypass blocking. XHTTP — the best balance of speed and stability. For a stable connection, fast TCP is a great fit. The rest are fallback options.

protocolHint.xhttp: The most modern protocol. Low latency, excellent DPI resistance. Our default recommendation — works on both stable and unstable connections.
protocolHint.tcp: Classic TCP + Reality (Vision). Maximum speed, minimal latency. Best for stable connections: gaming, video calls, streaming.
protocolHint.tcp-utls: TCP with TLS imitation (uTLS) — resistant to active probing. Slightly slower than plain TCP, but more reliable when your ISP actively blocks.
protocolHint.tcp-xudp: TCP + QUIC-like (XUDP). Faster on unstable links, carries both TCP and UDP. Great for messengers and VoIP.
protocolHint.tcp-mux: TCP with multiplexing — several sessions in one connection. Slower on short requests, but lower overhead. For browsing.
protocolHint.grpc: gRPC — slower than others, but nearly indistinguishable from regular HTTPS traffic. Use when other protocols are blocked by your ISP.

settings.previewHint: The first profile keeps your name as-is, the rest get suffixes name-2, name-3… Each has its own subscription.
settings.empty: No profiles yet. Create the first one.
settings.deleteKeyBody: Key «{{name}}» will be removed from server «{{server}}» together with its port binding and firewall rules. This action cannot be undone.
settings.mainProfileHint: Base HAPP profile with routes. Cannot be deleted from the app — it is used by the HAPP interface and quickstart. Remove it via SSH / server menu if needed.
settings.updated: Server updated to the latest version!
settings.uninstallBody: Xray, configurations, profiles, certificates and nginx will be removed from server «{{name}}». This action cannot be undone.
settings.uninstallFailed: Failed to remove the app from the server
settings.fpHint: Fingerprint imitates a browser TLS signature. It is a client-side property — Xray is not restarted, other routes are not affected. Refresh the subscription in your VPN client afterwards.
settings.fpRemember: Refresh the subscription in HAPP or another client after the change.
settings.sniWarning: SNI is bound to the port, not the profile. Changing it updates ALL profiles on this port and requires a NEW link — active connections will be dropped.
settings.sniReconnectHint: Get a new link after the change and update the configuration in clients.
settings.portWarning: Changing the port drops active connections — clients need a new link. If the chosen port is already used by a compatible transport, the SNI will be changed to that port's SNI.
settings.portReconnectHint: Get a new link after the change and update the configuration in clients.
